title: First step of the emission loop
statement: Let $E$ and $G$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, with $E$ having a positive number of work tapes, and let $e_e,e_x$ be states of $E$ and $g_e,g_x$ states of $G$. For any Boolean word $x$, the first step of the emission-loop machine, started in its copy state with the prefix of length $|x|$ stored on its first work tape and that tape's head at position $|x|$, is the configuration in its rewind-tape state with input head at position $|x|+1$ and first work-tape head at position $|x|-1$, with all other work tapes blank and their heads at zero, and with empty output.
hypotheses_covered: E and G are finite Turing machines over Bool
E has a positive number of work tapes
e_e and e_x are states of E
g_e and g_x are states of G
